import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*np.log(t) + p[2]*t/(p[3]+t)) + (p[4] + p[5]*np.log(t))*P**p[6] + p[7]*P**2 + p[8]*P + p[9]*P*t
